title: Herbal Gooey Peruvian Black Pudding Wrap
description: A kid-friendly Peruvian dish featuring black pudding, served in a crispy ssam-wrap with an ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly twist. Perfect for a quick and easy lunch or dinner.
instructions: Heat a medium non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Add the chopped fresh mint and cook for 1 minute until wilted.
Add the crushed garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the Peruvian black pudding and cook for 2 minutes breaking it up with a spoon.
Add the ayurvedic turmeric paste and Peruvian aji amarillo pepper sauce. Cook for 1 minute stirring constantly.
Warm the ssam-wraps according to the package instructions.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the black pudding mixture onto the center of each wrap.
Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrap to form a tight cylinder.
Cut the wraps in half if desired.
